newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Sept leading index 60, coincident 75 - EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan Sept leading index 60, coincident 75 - EPA.

text.p: Japan's diffusion index of leading economic indicators stood at 60 on a scale of 100 in September, rising above the so-called "boom or bust" mark of 50 after falling below that critical mark in August for the first time in five months, the Economic Planning Agency said on Thursday.
A breakdown of the indices of economic indicators follows:
The EPA said in a statement that the indicators showed that the economy was continuing to recover gradually.
A figure for the leading index above 50 is generally taken as suggesting the economy will expand in the coming months.
The coincident index measures current economic conditions, while the lagging index traces economic trends in the past few months.
Both indices of leading and coincident indicators were exactly in line with economists' forecasts.
